_meta.name: gamma_glm
_meta.description: Gamma regression: REG_GLM with family gamma for a strictly positive, right-skewed continuous outcome (income on customers.pulse) whose spread grows with its mean, where a Poisson (15_poisson.json) would pin the variance to the mean. Link log makes exp(coefficient) a multiplicative effect: each year of age multiplies expected income by about 0.998 (no effect here, p about 0.43). link inverse, the canonical gamma link, also fits.
